objective: Baseline prediction of nominal 12-month corrected distance visual acuity after keratoconus treatment; primary institutional comparison remains TG-PRK plus accelerated CXL versus accelerated CXL alone.
search_conclusion: No verified open dataset matching both specified treatment cohorts, linked baseline predictors, dated 10-14-month CDVA and paired images was found in this search. Public diagnostic imaging datasets cannot supply missing postoperative outcome labels.

recommendation.scope: Use the PLOS source only as a separately labelled external CXL feasibility cohort. Do not merge it with KKESH records, relabel conventional CXL as TG-PRK, or claim external validation before running a prespecified evaluation.
recommendation.next_step: Review the one patient with three records, absent laterality and correction-method labels; map source endpoints and predictors; run patient-grouped validation only after the external cohort's eligibility and endpoint are frozen. Nominal 1Y is not proof of the institutional 10-14-month calendar window.
